correctness.rationale: On P_n=C_n □ K2 (n>=3), a proper strong-odd coloring requires each cubic open-neighbor triple to have either one or three distinct colors. Two consecutive vertical columns form q-palette transfer states; q=4 yields 84 states. Direct independent enumeration found each state has exactly one successor and obtained six directed 2-cycles, six 4-cycles and eight 6-cycles. Hence A_n(4)=12·1_{2|n}+24·1_{4|n}+48·1_{6|n}; there are no odd four-palette closed walks, including colorings with fewer colors. Even n>=4 have exactly two optimal bipartition colorings; n=3 has graph square K6 and needs six. Explicit legal 5-color closed walks of lengths 4,5,7 share one initial two-column state and concatenate to every odd n>=5, giving χ_so=5 then; the general 5-palette number is exactly tr(T5^n) with 260 states, checked in given proof and source verifier for n=5,7,9,11. Independent 84-state exhaustive cycle classification is complete for its finite transition system; this is a logically valid finite certificate for arbitrary n because n-length colorings are closed walks. The infinite construction follows from explicit common-based loops, not finite n sampling.

Ordinary odd colorings, and strong odd crown graphs in Resultary, concern a different invariant or graph. Searches found no same cyclic-prism named-palette table. A differently indexed old exact prism enumeration remains possible, so originality is best knowledge, not a global priority certificate.

The exact forced 2/4/6 transition periods and tr(T5^n) enumerator offer motivated structural and counting data beyond the chromatic value; the large finite transfer system is completely specified rather than an unexamined output table.
